name: Forgotten Memories
source:
As the protagonist, you awaken after a mysterious illness, having lost all memories of your past. Returning to your luxurious estate, you are welcomed by three beautiful maids, each with their own unique personalities and hidden desires.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为主角，你在一场神秘的疾病后醒来，失去了过去的所有记忆。回到你的豪华庄园，三位美丽的女仆欢迎你，每个人都有自己独特的个性和隐藏的欲望。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113260/]Steam[/url]]
